title: Sample: settled late-autumn weather
summary: Mostly clear mornings with cloud building in the afternoon. Nights are well below freezing above 4000 m, so carry a warm sleeping bag and layers. (Invented example for late November, not a live report.)

title: Sample: very cold nights around Gorak Shep
summary: Clear and windy up high, with hard frost overnight. Water bottles and hoses can freeze. (Invented example for late November, not a live report.)

title: Sample: Lukla flights best early
summary: Morning flights are running more reliably than afternoon ones. Keep a spare day in your plan for weather delays. (Invented example for late November, not a live report.)

title: Sample: icy early start on Thorong La
summary: Patches of ice on the climb to the pass and strong wind by late morning. Start before dawn and bring microspikes. (Invented example for late November, not a live report.)

title: Sample: icy shaded sections above Deurali
summary: Shaded stretches stay frozen until late morning. Check with lodges about avalanche risk after any fresh snow. (Invented example for late November, not a live report.)

title: Sample: frost and wind on the Mardi ridge
summary: Clear views in the morning with cloud rising from below by midday. The upper ridge is frosty and exposed. (Invented example for late November, not a live report.)

title: Sample: snow patches near Larkya La
summary: Firm snow on the upper approach. Cross early and check with your guide before setting off. (Invented example for late November, not a live report.)

title: Sample: dry, clear days in Langtang
summary: Good visibility and dry trails. Temperatures drop sharply once the sun leaves the valley. (Invented example for late November, not a live report.)
